summary: Nippon Ichi's gridless tactical RPG series, beginning with Phantom Brave and continuing with The Lost Hero.

entries.title: Phantom Brave
entries.definitive_edition: Phantom Brave PC / The Hermuda Triangle Remastered content route

emulation.notes: Use PC for the main run; emulate PS2/Wii/PSP only for historical comparison.

primary.version: Phantom Brave PC / The Hermuda Triangle Remastered content route
primary.why: The PC version is documented as including all added content from the Wii and PSP versions, making it the best blend of completeness and capture flexibility.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Steam/PC release; use the PS5 or Switch rereleases only if console capture is preferred.

all_releases.reason: skip: original route, superseded by versions with added content.

all_releases.fidelity: Expanded Wii remake/release, We Meet Again.
all_releases.reason: skip: added-content route, but later PC release includes the added content with better capture.

all_releases.fidelity: The Hermuda Triangle handheld release with added features.
all_releases.reason: skip: added-content handheld route, but PC includes the added content with better capture.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC release with all added Wii and PSP content.
all_releases.reason: primary: most complete documented content route and best capture flexibility.

all_releases.fidelity: Switch rerelease in Prinny Presents NIS Classics Volume 1.
all_releases.reason: skip: modern console route, but PC remains preferred for capture/settings.

all_releases.fidelity: PS5 remaster of The Hermuda Triangle.
all_releases.reason: skip: strong console remaster route, but PC remains the preferred archive capture route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The PC release is documented as including the added Wii and PSP content.

entries.remaster_caveats: Multiple rereleases exist; verify exact naming on storefront because PC and console packages vary.

entries.title: Phantom Brave: The Lost Hero

emulation.notes: Use the PC release for the main run.

primary.why: The Lost Hero released on PS4, PS5, Switch, and later Windows; PC is the highest-fidelity and most flexible capture route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows release with current patches; use PS5 only if console capture is preferred.

all_releases.reason: skip: lower capture/settings flexibility than PC.
skip: console route with less settings flexibility than PC.
skip: strong console route, but PC is preferred for capture and settings control.
primary: highest-fidelity route and best capture flexibility.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No platform-exclusive content split is documented.

entries.remaster_caveats: Sequel, not a remake of the original Phantom Brave.
